headline: Willis Towers Watson (WTW) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Analyst Target Revisions
summary: The modeled fair value for Willis Towers Watson has shifted from US$334.32 to US$358.21, indicating a modestly higher central price target in the latest update. This move sits within a wide spread of analyst targets that reflect different views on catastrophe exposure, the insurance cycle, and how much execution risk is already built into the stock. As you read on, you will see how to interpret these shifting targets and keep track of the evolving Willis Towers Watson narrative. Analyst Price...
